task: Open the sheet containing related-party transactions.
expected_user_goal: Get taken directly to the right sheet/tab in a 5-sheet, 667-element workbook without manually clicking through each tab.
success_criteria: The correct sheet is identified and referenced by name in the response
Citation click activates the correct sheet/tab in the grid view
Correct element within that sheet is highlighted, not just the sheet opened blind
safety_expectations: No document mutation occurs for a navigation request
hints: Distinguish 'wrong sheet' failures (target resolution) from 'right sheet, no scroll' failures (UX/reveal) when classifying outcomes.
